title: FizKall's hygge pack
description: A little pack that i made so i can use it on my own Server
body:
FizKall's hygge pack adds some mods that dont alter the game to much while still bringing alot of new blocks to build with and places to explore, its ment to expand on the on posiblities that minecraft already have for house building and exploration. While also enchaning the ambients of the world with Ambient Sounds.


It also adds some quality of life mods that makes everyday stuff easier like the Hoe Harvester and Veinminer enchant
